title: Circulant mass compatibility and a six-body temporal Fourier obstruction
exact_target: Determine whether a Newtonian equal-time-shift choreography forces all masses to be equal.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002540 (AIM-PHYSICS-0048). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
